reason: Report is a multi-jurisdiction survey of GDPR-inspired data governance frameworks covering Japan APPI, Canada Bill C-27, Brazil ANPD, EU EDPB, Quebec Law 25, and eight US state comprehensive privacy laws. None of the known privacy subcategories (state-comprehensive-laws, federal-legislation, enforcement-actions, data-breach, childrens-privacy, health-data, financial-privacy) adequately captures international/comparative regulatory frameworks. A new 'international-frameworks' subcategory is proposed to house cross-jurisdictional and comparative law surveys.
